lenses.cartographyUse: Reject single-parent trees; allow multi-role/multi-placement identities; treat major regions as projections over a graph rather than ontology nodes.
lenses.principle: Canonical architecture can be a typed responsibility hypergraph; explanatory family views need not become semantic identities or roots.

lenses.cartographyUse: Never require a field to expose a primitive/root merely to deserve representation or major navigational prominence.
lenses.principle: Zero numbered Foundations can be a positive coherent architecture; derived theory can support a mature owner.

lenses.cartographyUse: Reject institutional/technology vocabulary as ontology authority; distinguish core domains from specializations, bridges and realization mechanisms.
lenses.principle: Engineering nouns and historical stacks are contingent projections; stable owner structure is a typed responsibility graph with specialization and explicit imports.

lenses.cartographyUse: Allow AXIS and BRIDGE structures without root promotion; do not infer metaphysical fundamentality from navigation.
lenses.principle: Derived != unreal; question/claim grammars, modal/process/property/temporal axes need not be ontic roots; numbering is not ontology priority.

lenses.cartographyUse: Do not promote genetics, health, cognition, engineering subfields, or other deep areas merely because they are important, lesionable, useful or institutionally large.
lenses.principle: Deep != Primitive; OperationallyUseful != Foundation; navigation families are views over stable identities.

lenses.cartographyUse: Prefer explicit scope/firewalls over domain inflation; avoid turning adjacent social concepts into one super-region.
lenses.principle: A coherent owner can have zero numbered Foundations and a non-numbered architecture while excluding broad neighboring notions such as generic institutions/governance/value.

lenses.cartographyUse: CanonicalMajorRegion must be a navigation projection and cannot become semantic authority.
lenses.principle: Atlas is a generated exploration/recovery projection, not owner truth.

rule: These owner-native Ordivon theories may generate hypotheses, negative controls and topology tests. They MUST NOT be counted as external evidence that a human knowledge field exists, nor mint External Reference World truth.
